ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit theft via ntdsutil 'Install From Media' (IFM)
ucs.description: Hunts Volt Typhoon / Vanguard Panda / VOLTZITE's signature offline AD credential extraction: invoking ntdsutil.exe with 'ifm' / 'create full' / 'activate instance ntds' on a domain controller to snapshot NTDS.dit + SYSTEM hive for offline DPAPI/Kerberos cracking. Called out in CISA AA24-038A and CrowdStrike's Vanguard Panda reporting as the actor's preferred LOTL credential-access path because it leaves no implant.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as first max(_time) as last values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Processes WHERE (Processes.process_name="ntdsutil.exe" OR Processes.parent_process_name="ntdsutil.exe") AND (Processes.process="*ifm*" OR Processes.process="*create full*" OR Processes.process="*activate instance ntds*" OR Processes.process="*create ifm*") BY Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user, "(?i)\$$") | sort - first
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe" or InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ifm", "create full", "activate instance ntds", "create ifm")
    or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("ifm", "create full", "activate instance ntds", "create ifm")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"          // strip machine accounts (legit AD backup agents run as SYSTEM)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          GrandParent = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\ntdsutil.exe" or ParentProcessName endswith "\\ntdsutil.exe"
| where CommandLine has_any ("ifm", "create full", "activate instance ntds", "create ifm")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"     // strip machine accounts
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName,
          NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit Extraction via ntdsutil IFM
id: 9e1d5b1f-ab8e-4a4f-a8a1-2c1b9f4c0b21
status: experimental
description: Detects ntdsutil.exe being invoked with IFM / 'create full' / 'activate instance ntds' arguments. Volt Typhoon (Vanguard Panda, VOLTZITE) uses this LOLBin technique on domain controllers to snapshot NTDS.dit for offline credential extraction (CISA AA24-038A).
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-038a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/18
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\ntdsutil.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' ifm'
      - 'create full'
      - 'create ifm'
      - 'activate instance ntds'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Approved domain-controller backup operations using ntdsutil IFM (rare; should be ticketed and source from a known admin jump host)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.003
  - attack.g1017
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\\ntdsutil.exe OR *\\NTDSUtil.exe OR *\\NTDSUTIL.EXE) OR @ParentImage:(*\\ntdsutil.exe OR *\\NTDSUtil.exe OR *\\NTDSUTIL.EXE)) @CommandLine:(*ifm* OR *IFM* OR *"create full"* OR *"activate instance ntds"*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\ntdsutil\.exe$/i OR ParentBaseFileName=/^ntdsutil\.exe$/i)
| CommandLine=/(\bifm\b|create\s+full|create\s+ifm|activate\s+instance\s+ntds)/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=[count(as=Hits), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen)])
| sort(FirstSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: ntdsutil.exe with IFM/'create full' on a DC is one of the most actor-specific TTPs in the catalogue. Volt Typhoon explicitly avoids dropping tools like Mimikatz/secretsdump and instead uses this signed-in-the-box binary to stage NTDS.dit (CISA AA24-038A, CrowdStrike Vanguard Panda). ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon LOTL discovery burst on a domain controller (net / nltest / ldifde / wmic chained)
ucs.description: Catches Volt Typhoon's hallmark hands-on-keyboard reconnaissance: a single interactive shell on a domain controller (or DC-adjacent server) firing >=6 distinct built-in discovery binaries (net, nltest, ldifde, dsquery, wmic, whoami, quser, systeminfo, ipconfig, tasklist) inside a 10-minute window. CISA AA24-038A and Microsoft's Volt Typhoon writeup both document this exact sequence as the actor's discovery profile post-initial-access from compromised SOHO edge devices.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count dc(Processes.process_name) as distinct_tools values(Processes.process_name) as tools values(Processes.process) as cmds min(_time) as first max(_time) as last FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Processes WHERE Processes.process_name IN ("net.exe","net1.exe","nltest.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe","whoami.exe","tasklist.exe","quser.exe","wmic.exe","ldifde.exe","dsquery.exe","netstat.exe","arp.exe") AND Processes.parent_process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wsmprovhost.exe") BY Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_id _time span=10m | where distinct_tools >= 6 AND NOT match(user, "(?i)\$$") | sort - first
ucs.kql:
let LOTL = dynamic(["net.exe","net1.exe","nltest.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe","whoami.exe","tasklist.exe","quser.exe","wmic.exe","ldifde.exe","dsquery.exe","netstat.exe","arp.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where FileName in~ (LOTL)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wsmprovhost.exe")  // interactive / WinRM shells only
| summarize DistinctTools = dcount(FileName),
            Tools = make_set(FileName, 25),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 25),
            First = min(Timestamp),
            Last  = max(Timestamp),
            Parent = any(InitiatingProcessFileName)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessId, bin(Timestamp, 10m)
| where DistinctTools >= 6     // 6 = empirical floor; benign admin sessions rarely run >5 distinct recon LOLBins in 10 min
| order by First desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LOTL = dynamic(["net.exe","net1.exe","nltest.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe","whoami.exe","tasklist.exe","quser.exe","wmic.exe","ldifde.exe","dsquery.exe","netstat.exe","arp.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend BinName  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ParentBin = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where BinName in (LOTL)
| where ParentBin in ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wsmprovhost.exe")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| summarize DistinctTools = dcount(BinName),
            Tools = make_set(BinName, 25),
            SampleCmds = make_set(CommandLine, 25),
            First = min(TimeGenerated),
            Last  = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, SubjectLogonId, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where DistinctTools >= 6
| order by First desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\net.exe OR *\\NET.EXE OR *\\net1.exe OR *\\NET1.EXE OR *\\nltest.exe OR *\\NLTEST.EXE OR *\\systeminfo.exe OR *\\SYSTEMINFO.EXE OR *\\ipconfig.exe OR *\\IPCONFIG.EXE OR *\\whoami.exe OR *\\WHOAMI.EXE OR *\\tasklist.exe OR *\\TASKLIST.EXE OR *\\quser.exe OR *\\QUSER.EXE OR *\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE OR *\\ldifde.exe OR *\\LDIFDE.EXE OR *\\dsquery.exe OR *\\DSQUERY.EXE OR *\\netstat.exe OR *\\NETSTAT.EXE OR *\\arp.exe OR *\\ARP.EXE) @ParentImage:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\PWSH.EXE OR *\\wsmprovhost.exe OR *\\WsmProvHost.exe) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(net|net1|nltest|systeminfo|ipconfig|whoami|tasklist|quser|wmic|ldifde|dsquery|netstat|arp)\.exe$/i
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(cmd|powershell|pwsh|wsmprovhost)\.exe$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| bin_time := bucket(span=10m, field=@timestamp)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, AuthenticationId, bin_time], function=[count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=DistinctTools), collect([ImageFileName], as=Tools), collect([CommandLine], as=SampleCmds), min(@timestamp, as=First)])
| DistinctTools >= 6
| sort(First, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: The exact LOTL discovery burst (net group / net user / nltest /dclist / ldifde -f / wmic /node / quser / systeminfo / ipconfig /all / netstat -ano) chained from a single cmd.exe is the documented Volt Typhoon TTP set — Microsoft and CISA both publish near-identical command sequences captured from incidents at US energy/water/telecom victims. Constraining to (a) parent = cmd/powershell/pwsh/wsmprov
